description: Accumulated satellite-detected water extents in Gaborone, South East and Kgatleng Districts, Botswana as of 23 to 25 February 2025 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20250220BWA, GDACS ID: 1103128 This map illustrates the satellite-detected accumulated flood extent in Gaborone, South East District, Botswana, as observed from Planet imagery and very high-resolution Pleiades imagery acquired between 23 and 25 February 2025. Within the analyzed area of approximately 700 km², an estimated 30 km² appears to be affected by floodwaters. Coverage: Botswana. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-02-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
